name: Salary withheld after resignation
expected: Clarifies that earned wages cannot be arbitrarily withheld during notice period.
prompt: The moment I submitted my resignation email, the company withheld my current month's running salary.
raw_response:
Main samajh sakta hoon ki resignation ke baad salary rok diya jana aapke liye kitna pareshan karne wala ho sakta hai.

### | Your Situation (Aapki Situation)
Aapne apni company ko resignation email bhej diya hai aur company ne uske turant baad aapke current month ki running salary ko withhold yaani rok liya hai. Ye mamla aapke employment aur final settlement se juda hua hai.

### | Your Legal Position (Aapke Kanooni Adhikar)
- **State Shops and Commercial Establishments Act:** Iske antargat, private aur commercial establishments mein kaam karne wale employees ko unki resignation ke baad earned wages aur final settlement ka paisa tay samay (aamtaur par 3 se 15 din ke bhitar) milna zaroori hai.
- **The Payment of Wages Act, 1936 - Section 5 & Section 15:** Section 5 ke anusar, wages ka bhugtan wage period khatam hone ke 7 din ke andar hona chahiye. Agar bina kisi kanooni karan ke salary roki ya delay ki jati hai, toh Section 15 ke tehat aap Labour Commissioner ya designated Authority ke paas application daal sakte hain aur roki gayi rakam ke sath compensation ki maang kar sakte hain.
- **The Payment of Wages Act, 1936 - Section 7:** Employer sirf wahi deductions kar sakta hai jo kanooni roop se manya ho (jaise ki tax ya provident fund). Bina kisi formal inquiry ke arbitrary ya unauthorized salary deduction karna kanooni taur par galat hai.

### | Practical Next Steps (Agla Kadam)
1. Gather evidence: Apne resignation email ki copy, employment agreement, payslips aur company ke sath hui saari email ya message ki history ko ekatha kar lein.
2. Send written demand notice granting 15 days: Company ke HR aur management ko ek formal written demand notice bhejiye, jisme The Payment of Wages Act, 1936 ke Section 5 ka hawala dete hue 15 din ke andar apni running salary clearance ki maang karein.
3. Appropriate forum: Agar company 15 din ke andar salary nahi deti hai, toh aap apne area ke Labour Commissioner ke paas formal complaint darj kar sakte hain.

### ℹ️ Information I still need from you (Zaroori Jankari)
Kripya mujhe batayein ki aap kis state mein kaam kar rahe hain aur aapke roke gaye running salary ki lagbhag kitni rakam (amount) hai?

citations.act_name: State Shops and Commercial Establishments Acts
citations.section: Settlement of Dues and Service Conditions Provision
citations.title: Statutory Payment of Earned Salary and Notice Pay for Private/Commercial Employees
citations.description: State-specific legislation (e.g., Delhi Shops Act, Karnataka Shops & Commercial Establishments Act, Maharashtra Shops Act) governing commercial and IT/office establishments. Mandates clearance of earned wages and final settlement upon termination or resignation within 3 to 15 days.

citations.title: Deductions which may be made from wages
citations.description: Strictly enumerates permissible deductions (such as authorized provident fund, income tax, or willful damage shown after formal inquiry). Any arbitrary or unauthorized deduction is unlawful.

citations.title: Time of payment of wages and Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment
citations.description: Wages must be paid before the expiry of the 7th day after the wage period (or 10th day if more than 1,000 persons employed). Section 15 provides for application to the designated Authority for delayed wages with compensation up to ten times the amount deducted/delayed.

citations.title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
citations.description: When a contract has been broken, the party who suffers by such breach is entitled to receive, from the party who has broken the contract, compensation for any loss or damage caused to him thereby.
